title: Sections over a weakly contractible affine preserve colimits
statement:
Let $W$ be an affine weakly contractible object of a pro-étale site and $A$ a sheaf of rings. The functor
$M\mapsto\Gamma(W,M)$ from sheaves of $A$-modules to abelian groups is exact and preserves all colimits; in
particular filtered colimits and direct sums.

proof.text: Apply [det-pe-sections-limits-colimits] to the given ring sheaf R and affine weakly contractible W, once for universe-zero diagrams and once for the specified diagram universes. Install the resulting preservation of limits and colimits for the module-valued evaluation functor E. The category and evaluated linear maps are those of [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].

Let U forget the action of R(W). Mathlib ModuleCat.restrictCoextendScalarsAdj for Int.castRingHom R(W) makes restriction to integer modules a left adjoint. The forgetful functor from integer modules to abelian groups is an equivalence (ModuleCat.forget₂AddCommGroupIsEquivalence), hence a left adjoint. Their composite is naturally isomorphic to U by identity maps on the underlying groups. Transport the composite adjunction along this natural isomorphism. Adjunction.leftAdjoint_preservesColimits gives preservation of colimits of the specified size and of universe-zero diagrams. The module universe max (u+1) r v contains the section-ring universe r, so coextension is available without constraining either diagram universe. These are the colimit universal properties of [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

Mathlib ModuleCat.forget₂AddCommGroup_preservesLimits gives preservation of finite limits by U. Its universe-zero colimit preservation gives preservation of finite colimits. Compose these with the finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation of E and apply exactFunctor_iff. Finally compose the arbitrary-size colimit preservation of E and U using comp_preservesColimits. Both conjuncts concern exactly E followed by U, including empty, discrete and filtered diagrams; no commutativity assumption on R is used.
